title: Malformed ?url= on /api/shorten crashes with 500
body:
`GET /api/shorten?url=http://` returns `500 internal error`.

Expected: any URL that can't be parsed, or isn't http(s), returns `400` with a JSON body `{ "error": "..." }` — the same validation `POST /links` uses. Examples that must return 400: `http://`, `::::`, `https://exa mple.com`, `javascript:alert(1)`. Valid URLs keep returning 201.
